description: Header file defining the API and data structures for the MCUmgr image management client in Zephyr OS, including functions for initializing the client, uploading images, reading/writing image state, and erasing image slots.

methods.name: img_mgmt_client_init
methods.description: Initializes the image management client with SMP client and image list buffer.

methods.name: img_mgmt_client_upload_init
methods.description: Prepares the client for uploading an image, setting size, slot, and optional hash.

methods.name: img_mgmt_client_upload
methods.description: Uploads a part of the image data to the device.

methods.name: img_mgmt_client_state_write
methods.description: Writes or confirms the image state, optionally using a hash.

methods.name: img_mgmt_client_state_read
methods.description: Reads the current image state from the device.
